name: Everything scored on two axes at once
useWhen: Ten to thirty-five candidates have to be prioritised and the conversation is about relative position — what is nearly equal, what is clearly ahead — not about which named box each one falls in.

focal.note: Deliberately tiny. No single item is the point; the shape of the cloud is. A hero item here would break the claim that these were all scored the same way.

replacesNote: Nothing in the kit does this. Prioritisation decks currently fall back to a bulleted list, which throws away the only thing the slide exists to show.

deviations.source: blue and purple pills, outside the brand palette
deviations.why: The source was built outside the system. Reproducing off-brand colour to be faithful would be faithful to a mistake.
A 2x2 sorts into four named boxes; this plots continuously. Building the labelled thing would have left the real gap open.
